tab.label: MobileUI
tab.description: Everything this edition adds to CloudCLI, in one place.

autoExpandThinkingDescription: Open thinking blocks by default, also while they stream. You can still collapse a block yourself.

skin.label: Skin
skin.description: The visual style of the interface; light and dark work with every skin

dotField.label: Dot field
dotField.description: The dotted texture behind the conversation

chamfers.label: Chamfered edges
chamfers.description: Cut corners on the tab strip, the composer and your messages

monoLabels.label: Monospace tab labels
monoLabels.description: Uppercase instrument-style labels on the workspace tabs

squareMarks.label: Square status marks
squareMarks.description: Square instead of round status indicators

stars.label: Starfield
stars.description: Drifting stars behind the glass panels

glassContrast.label: Glass contrast
glassContrast.description: How clearly panels and bubbles stand out from the sky

grid.label: Background grid
grid.description: The fine grid in the background

halo.label: Halo and glow
halo.description: A soft light from the top of the screen, and glowing status dots in dark mode

pillTabs.label: Pill tabs
pillTabs.description: Fully rounded tab strips, like the navigation of the website

assistantBubble.label: Agent reply bubble
assistantBubble.description: How the agent’s written replies are framed in the conversation

serverSettings.title: Server
serverSettings.description: The CloudCLI server on this computer, started by the scripts in scripts/server.
serverSettings.testPortal: This is the test portal (port {{port}}). Restart and Stop act on it only.
serverSettings.unavailable: This server was not started by the scripts in scripts/server, so it cannot be controlled here.
serverSettings.pendingBuildHint: Ready to go live: a restart makes it the running build.
serverSettings.activeWorkValue: Replies being written: {{turns}} · sessions with background work: {{sessions}} · background tasks: {{tasks}}
serverSettings.autostartDescription: Start the server in the background when you log in to this computer.
serverSettings.autostartDisabled: Switched off by the system (on Windows: Task Manager > Startup apps). Turning it on here switches it back on.
serverSettings.autostartLiveOnly: Applies to the live server only; change it there.
serverSettings.actionsDescription: Both end every reply being written and all background tasks, and this page loses its connection. After a restart it reconnects by itself; after a stop the server has to be started again on the computer.
serverSettings.confirmRestart: Restart the server now? This page loses its connection for a moment.
serverSettings.confirmStop: Stop the server? This page stops working until the server is started again on the computer.
serverSettings.confirmWork: Running work will be ended and cannot be resumed. {{work}}
serverSettings.restartScheduled: Restarting… This page reconnects when the server is back.
serverSettings.stopScheduled: The server is stopping. Start it again on the computer (scripts/server/start).

showThinking.label: Show thinking
showThinking.description: The same switch as in quick settings.

files.showIgnoredDescription: List gitignored files and folders in the Files tab, dimmed. Same as the eye button there; remembered on this device only.

phone.swipeNavigationDescription: On a phone, swipe left or right to switch workspace tabs; swiping back from the first tab opens the menu.
phone.homeRecents: Recent conversations on the home screen
phone.homeRecentsDescription: With no project open, list the latest conversations and their projects. Off: the original “choose a project” screen.
phone.compactComposerDescription: On a phone, keep the buttons under the message box on one row: the commands list, scheduling, voice input and clear context move into a “⋯” menu. Typing / still opens the commands. Off: every button in the row, which can wrap onto two rows.

serverSwitches.intro: Server switches: saved on the server and used from its next restart. A value set in the server configuration always wins.
serverSwitches.stagingNote: This is the test portal: these switches affect only the test portal (it has its own database).
serverSwitches.lockedHint: Set in the server configuration ({{key}}), which always wins. Change it in _server/config.json.
serverSwitches.appliesAfterRestart: Saved. Applies after the server restarts.
serverSwitches.restartManually: Restart the server on the computer to use it.

codexRuntime.label: Codex runtime
codexRuntime.description: How Codex conversations run: one process per message (exec, the default), or a long-lived app server with approvals and background terminals.

approvalTimeout.label: Approval timeout
approvalTimeout.description: How long a tool approval waits for your answer before it is declined.

backgroundHold.label: Background work limit
backgroundHold.description: How long a session with background tasks still running may stay silent before those tasks are stopped.

fileTreeMaxEntries.label: File tree limit
fileTreeMaxEntries.description: How many entries the Files tab loads at once in a very large project (default {{value}}). Folders beyond it load when opened.

extraReadRoots.label: Extra read-only folders
extraReadRoots.description: Folders outside the project that the in-chat file viewer may open, read-only. Absolute paths of existing folders, up to 20.
